title: President's Path
statementMd:
Good old Berland has $*n*$ cities and $*m*$ roads. Each road connects a pair of distinct cities and is bidirectional. Between any pair of cities, there is at most one road. For each road, we know its length.

We also know that the President will soon ride along the Berland roads from city $*s*$ to city $*t*$. Naturally, he will choose one of the shortest paths from $*s*$ to $*t*$, but nobody can say for sure which path he will choose.

The Minister for Transport is really afraid that the President might get upset by the state of the roads in the country. That is the reason he is planning to repair the roads in the possible President's path.

Making the budget for such an event is not an easy task. For all possible distinct pairs $*s*, *t*$ ($*s* < *t*$) find the number of roads that lie on at least one shortest path from $*s*$ to $*t*$.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integers $*n*, *m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*·(*n* - 1) / 2$) — the number of cities and roads, correspondingly. Then $*m*$ lines follow, containing the road descriptions, one description per line. Each description contains three integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}, *l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}, 1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$), where $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ are the numbers of the cities connected by the $*i*$-th road and $*l*_{*i*}$ is its length.

## Output

Print the sequence of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c37fde31a098626cbb7d832c868254ecd5d67d42.png) integers $*c*_{12}, *c*_{13}, ..., *c*_{1*n*}, *c*_{23}, *c*_{24}, ..., *c*_{2*n*}, ..., *c*_{*n* - 1, *n*}$, where $*c*_{*st*}$ is the number of roads that can lie on the shortest path from $*s*$ to $*t*$. Print the elements of sequence $*c*$ in the described order. If the pair of cities $*s*$ and $*t*$ don't have a path between them, then $*c*_{*st*} = 0$.
statementZhMd:
Good old Berland 有 $*n*$ 个城市和 $*m*$ 条道路。每条道路连接一对不同的城市，并且是双向的。任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。对于每条道路，我们都知道它的长度。

我们还知道，总统很快将沿着 Berland 的道路从城市 $*s*$ 前往城市 $*t*$。当然，他会选择从 $*s*$ 到 $*t*$ 的一条最短路径，但没有人能确定他究竟会选择哪条路径。

交通部长非常担心总统可能会因这个国家的道路状况而感到不满。因此，他计划维修总统可能经过的道路。

为这样的事件制定预算并不是一件容易的事。对于所有可能的不同城市对 $*s*, *t*$（$*s* < *t*$），求至少位于从 $*s*$ 到 $*t*$ 的一条最短路径上的道路数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含整数 $*n*, *m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 500$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*·(*n* - 1) / 2$）——城市和道路的数量。接下来有 $*m*$ 行，每行描述一条道路。每条描述包含三个整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}, *l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}$，$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$），其中 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ 是第 $*i*$ 条道路所连接的城市编号，$*l*_{*i*}$ 是该道路的长度。

## 输出格式

输出由 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c37fde31a098626cbb7d832c868254ecd5d67d42.png) 个整数 $*c*_{12}, *c*_{13}, ..., *c*_{1*n*}, *c*_{23}, *c*_{24}, ..., *c*_{2*n*}, ..., *c*_{*n* - 1, *n*}$ 组成的序列，其中 $*c*_{*st*}$ 表示可能位于从 $*s*$ 到 $*t*$ 的最短路径上的道路数量。请按照上述顺序输出序列 $*c*$ 的各个元素。如果城市 $*s*$ 和 $*t*$ 之间不存在路径，则 $*c*_{*st*} = 0$。
